title: Changing the style drops a stale enhanced prompt (reused card kept its old style's enhancement)
description: Found by Fabio 2026-10-27 testing 2.1.3. Reusing a MOSS-Image card brings its ENHANCED prompt along; picking a different style (Anime) then generates with the old enhancement (written for Psychedelic Pop: 'gouache... psychedelic cityscape...'), which overpowers the Anime LoRA - t2i_055 ran selector 1 correctly but looks like t2i_051 (selector 3). The app already detects it, but says so only inside the Enhance dialog (MpiPromptBox.js ~2820: 'Enhanced before the X style was picked'). Fabio's decision: when the user selects a different style, the previous enhanced prompt is removed (back to the user's own prompt). Not a 2.1.3 blocker. Member of the LTX 2.5 release umbrella MPI-1267.
